title: My dreams have been intense recently…I dreamt of my ex
content: Recently, I’ve been having very vivid dreams of people I know in my mall world. It’s interesting, because typically the scenery or where I am going is the first thing I think of when I wake. Last night I had a dream of my college boyfriend and all my friends, they all were meeting me at my house. When my ex walked through the door, it felt so real. I gave him the biggest hug and embraced him, crying my eyes out. My other friends that I haven’t seen in years were also there. I just felt like I wanted to go back. Idk if it’s causing my depression or a symptom of it…it’s very confusing to want to be in your dream world more than in your real life. I also started Wellbutrin 2 weeks ago and I wonder if that’s impacting me. I take melatonin also to help with sleep. IRL my ex is happily married, and I know going back to that would also never work out, so idk why my brain is dreaming of this time. Maybe it’s just a fantasy I am creating to escape my current reality.
